summary: Home Manager completed-phase systemd and launchd daemons preserve a caller's --config PATH or --config=PATH without appending a second config option; callers without one retain the default Fractal config path.

replay.detail: No durable state or replay change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule change.

compatibility.detail: Completed-phase daemon commands now honor extraArgs config selection like legacy commands. Multiple config options in completed target arguments fail a module assertion. Migration receipts, config fences and ExecCondition remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond normal Home Manager service activation.

manual.detail: No operator migration. Standalone regression: on dev3 from the repository root run gate-slot --class eval --max-wait 600 --max-hold 600 -- nix eval --impure --json --file nix/checks/hm-single-config.nix. The standalone test is not CI-registered; registration requires a later flake.nix change. The module assertion is included wherever existing Home Manager checks and downstream evaluations consume assertions.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; no state rollback is required.
